notes.title: Small Demo Update + Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest 2024!
notes.notes:
Heyo!

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/turnbased_rpg]Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest[/url] has begun until October 7 so please go and check other games along with our latest changes on the demo!

[h2]Demo Changes[/h2]

We have been working mainly on balancing the game, new extra nodes were added to the map, more interesting battle setups and two new enemies were added as well! For the full list of changes please check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1716760/discussions/0/4357873276727760977/]here[/url].

As usual we are open to feedback on here or [url=https://discord.com/invite/Fr25mZWynY]Discord[/url].
